book.gemcolony.gem_colony.name: Gem Colony Guide
book.gemcolony.gem_colony.tooltip: A guide to starting your own gem colony !
book.gemcolony.welcome.title: Welcome!
book.gemcolony.welcome.text: Welcome to Gem Colony! This guide will introduce you to the world of gems, their abilities, and how to build your colony.
book.gemcolony.chroma.items.title: It's not edible !
book.gemcolony.chroma.items.text: Chroma is an essential resource used in most gem technology, including gem creation. It comes in many colors, often influenced by the environment in which it forms. Learning where to find each color will help you develop your colony.
book.gemcolony.chroma.deposits.title: Chroma Deposits
book.gemcolony.chroma.deposits.text: Chroma Deposits are natural mineral formations that contain chroma. Deposits can be mined with an iron or higher tier pickaxe, having fortune applied may result in bigger yield.
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.title: So colorful...
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.text: The environment influences the colors of chroma found throughout the world. Explore different biomes to discover which colors can be obtained in each one.
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.white.text: White Chroma deposits tend to form on thick layers of [#](d8d8d8)**Snow**[#](), like those found in the [#](d8d8d8)**Snowy Slopes**[#]() biome.
Light Gray Chroma deposits form on [#](c6c6c6)**Stone**[#]() throughout the Overworld, especially in caves.
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.gray.text: Gray Chroma deposits form on [#](555555)**Deepslate**[#]() in Overworld caves.
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.black.text: Black Chroma deposits form on [#](303030)**Blackstone**[#]() in the Nether's [#](303030)**Basalt Deltas**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.brown.text: Brown Chroma deposits grow on [#](956532)**Coarse Dirt and Podzol**[#]() in biomes like the [#](956532)**Taiga**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.red.text: Red Chroma deposits absorb their fiery red hue from [#](ff5555)**Netherrack**[#]() in the [#](ff5555)**Nether Wastes**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.orange.text: Orange Chroma deposits grow on [#](ff8c00)**Red Sand**[#]() in the [#](ff8c00)**Badlands**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.yellow.text: Yellow Chroma deposits grow on [#](ffff55)**Sand**[#]() in [#](ffff55)**Deserts**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.lime.text: Lime Chroma deposits absorb their leafy green hue from the surrounding [#](aaff00)**Plants**[#]() in [#](aaff00)**Jungles**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.green.text: Green Chroma deposits grow on [#](55aa00)**Grass**[#]() in [#](55aa00)**Swamps**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.cyan.text: Cyan Chroma deposits grow on the [#](00aaaa)**Sea Floor**[#]().
Light Blue Chroma deposits absorb their light hue from [#](55ffff)**Clay**[#]() in [#](55ffff)**Lush Caves**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.blue.text: Blue Chroma deposits derive their cold hue from [#](5555ff)**icy biomes**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.purple.text: Purple Chroma deposits absorb the purple light of nearby flowers in [#](aa00aa)**Flower Forests**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.magenta.tex: Magenta Chroma deposits absorb the purple light of nearby flowers in [#](ff55ff)**Flower Forests**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_biomes.pink.text: Pink Chroma deposits absorb pink impurities from [#](ff9fcb)**Granite and Cinnabar**[#]() in [#](ff9fcb)**Sulfur Caves**[#]().
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.title: Growing crystals ?
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.text: Planting chroma seeds on certain blocks will make the crystals absorb their colors.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.chroma_see: Combine chroma and essence bottles of any color with water and stone to craft four chroma Seeds, which then can be planted for more chroma and more chroma seeds.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.white.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](d8d8d8)**Calcite**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a White Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.light_gray: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](c0c0c0)**Andesite**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Light Gray Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.gray.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](808080)**Deepslate**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Gray Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.black.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](404040)**Blackstone**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Black Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.brown.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](8b4513)**Dirt**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Brown Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.red.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](ff5555)**Netherrack**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Red Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.orange.tex: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](ffaa00)**Red Sand**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into an Orange Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.yellow.tex: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](ffff55)**Sand**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Yellow Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.lime.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](aaff00)**Moss Block**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Lime Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.green.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](55ff55)**Grass Block**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Green Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.cyan.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](55ffff)**Prismarine**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Cyan Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.light_blue: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](55aaff)**Clay**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Light Blue Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.blue.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](5555ff)**Blue Ice**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Blue Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.purple.tex: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](aa00ff)**Amethyst Block**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Purple Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.magenta.te: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](ff55ff)**Purpur Block**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Magenta Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_farming.pink.text: Plant a Chroma Seed on [#](ffaaaa)**Granite**[#](). As it grows through four stages, it transforms into a Pink Chroma Deposit.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.title: Finding Chroma
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.text: Chroma can sometimes be found in chests hidden throughout the world. Explore these structures and search their chests to discover different colors.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.ancient: [#](d8d8d8)**White Chroma**[#]() may be found in chests hidden within Ancient Cities.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.dungeon: [#](c6c6c6)**Light Gray Chroma**[#]() may be found in dungeon chests.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.minesha: [#](555555)**Gray Chroma**[#]() may be found in chests left behind in abandoned mineshafts.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.bastion: [#](303030)**Black Chroma**[#]() may be found in chests within Bastion Remnants in bastion treasure areas.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.pillage: [#](956532)**Brown Chroma**[#]() may be found in chests at Pillager Outposts and Woodland Mansions.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.nether_: [#](ff5555)**Red Chroma**[#]() may be found in chests hidden within Nether Fortresses.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.desert_: [#](ff8c00)**Orange Chroma**[#]() and [#](ffff55)**Yellow Chroma**[#]() may be found in Desert Pyramid treasure chests.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.jungle_: [#](aaff00)**Lime Chroma**[#]() and [#](55aa00)**Green Chroma**[#]() may be found in Jungle Temple chests.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.underwa: [#](00aaaa)**Cyan Chroma**[#]() may be found in chests within small and large underwater ruins.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.treasur: [#](55ffff)**Light Blue Chroma**[#]() may be found in shipwreck treasure chests and buried treasure chests.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.igloo.t: [#](5555ff)**Blue Chroma**[#]() may be found in the chests of igloos scattered across snowy regions.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.ruined_: [#](aa00ff)**Purple Chroma**[#]() may be found in chests near ruined Nether Portals.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.end_cit: [#](ff55ff)**Magenta Chroma**[#]() may be found in treasure chests within End Cities.
book.gemcolony.chroma_structures.village: [#](ff9fcb)**Pink Chroma**[#]() may be found in certain village chests, including those in temples, armorer houses, and toolsmith houses.
book.gemcolony.essence.buckets.title: Essence Buckets
book.gemcolony.essence.buckets.text: Essence is the key to creating gem life, it's extracted from the Diamonds who are nowhere to be found and from Mineral Shards. A bucket of essence holds 1,000mb.
book.gemcolony.essence.bottles.title: Essence Bottles
book.gemcolony.essence.bottles.text: Essence can also be stored in bottles, although its a quarter of a bucket's capacity. A bottle of essence holds 250mb.
book.gemcolony.essence_structures.title: The Lost Essence
book.gemcolony.essence_structures.text: Essence was usually extracted from Diamonds, but now that they have disappeared, the only way to obtain it is by finding old and ruined extraction chambers and collecting the leftover essence.
book.gemcolony.essence_structures.yellow: This is where you can find Yellow Essence.
book.gemcolony.essence_structures.blue.t: This is where you can find Blue Essence.
book.gemcolony.essence_structures.pink.t: This is where you can find Pink Essence.
The extraction chamber for White Essence has yet to be implemented.
book.gemcolony.gem_colony.gems.name: Gems
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.title: So tiny!
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.text: Starter Gems are the first kind of Gems you will create. They emerge from certain substrates when the right Essence Bottle is poured onto them.
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.pebble.title: Pebble
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.mica.title: Mica
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.shale.title: Shale
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.nacre.title: Nacre
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.pebble.text: Use a [#](ff9fcb)**Pink Essence Bottle**[#]() on [#](ff9fcb)**Gravel**[#]() to give life to a [#](ff9fcb)**Pebble**[#]().
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.mica.text: Use a [#](f5c71a)**Yellow Essence Bottle**[#]() on [#](f5c71a)**Sand**[#]() to give life to a [#](f5c71a)**Mica**[#]().
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.shale.text: Use a [#](5555ff)**Blue Essence Bottle**[#]() on [#](5555ff)**Clay**[#]() to give life to a [#](5555ff)**Shale**[#]().
book.gemcolony.starter_gems.nacre.text: Use a [#](d8d8d8)**White Essence Bottle**[#]() on [#](d8d8d8)**Calcite**[#]() to give life to a [#](d8d8d8)**Nacre**[#]().
book.gemcolony.pebble.text: [#](ff9fcb)**Pebbles**[#]() are very good at constructing different gem structures, they can construct ... (W.I.P).
book.gemcolony.shale.text: [#](5555ff)**Shales**[#]() are caring constructors. They can construct [#](5555ff)**Incubators**[#]() capable of nurturing gems of higher quality, giving your colony stronger and more capable gems.
book.gemcolony.mica.text: [#](f5c71a)**Micas**[#]() are gifted technological constructors, specializing in complex machinery and precision engineering. They can construct advanced devices such as [#](f5c71a)**Injectors**[#](), helping your colony create more gems.
book.gemcolony.nacre.text: [#](d8d8d8)**Nacres**[#]() are the mother-of-pearl of your colony. They can construct [#](d8d8d8)**Shells**[#]() where Pearls can form, bringing their beauty to your colony.
book.gemcolony.injector_multiblock.name: Injector
book.gemcolony.injector_multiblock.text: The Injector is the main to create gems and expand you colony, it's made from 4 parts: a drill to inject the gem seed, a tank to hold the essence, a crystal to power it and 4 legs to stabilize it although the injector can work without them.
book.gemcolony.shell_multiblock.name: Shell
book.gemcolony.shell_multiblock.text: The Shell is an incubator in sorts for Pearls, it takes White essence to give life to a pearl, a chroma to give her color and a gem seed the base of most gems.
